homepage.title: Foliant, all your documents ready online
homepage.subtitle: Convert, compress, organize, and protect files from one clear, fast, multilingual interface.

launcher.title: What do you need to do now?
launcher.text: The most used actions stay accessible from the homepage without overwhelming users with the full catalog.

popular.compressPdf: Reduce a heavy PDF in seconds.
popular.mergePdf: Combine multiple PDFs in the right order.
popular.pdfToWord: Turn a PDF into an editable Word document.
popular.imageToPdf: Create a clean PDF from your images.
popular.protectPdf: Add a password to the document.
popular.watermark: Mark a PDF with visible text.

categories.title: A clear logic for every document task
categories.text: Foliant separates fast simple engines from advanced use cases that need more control.

items.fromPdf: Export PDFs to editable formats or images.
items.toPdf: Turn Word files, images, or Markdown into PDFs.
items.compress: Make heavy files easier to send.
items.edit: Merge, split, rotate, number, or watermark PDFs.
items.secure: Protect, unlock, or visually sign documents.
items.ai: Prepare OCR, translation, and summaries for premium use.

flow.title: A short flow: file, action, result
flow.text: Tool pages keep upload at the top. The homepage explains the product, helps users choose a tool, and shows the plans.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.text: PDF, image, or Office document depending on the selected tool.

process.title: Choose the action
process.text: Compression, conversion, organization, protection, or visual signing.

download.title: Get the result
download.text: Direct download, then automatic cleanup of temporary files.

pricing.title: Clear free limits, then premium options
pricing.text: Pricing should be visible from the start so users understand free use, urgent needs, and regular usage.

free.name: Free
free.description: For testing and simple document tasks.

pass.name: 24h Pass
pass.description: For a one-time need without a subscription.

pricing.note: Payments, accounts, and quotas will be activated in the monetization block. Prices can still change before public launch.

trust.title: Built for speed without making the product confusing
trust.text: The promise stays simple: a clear international site, temporary files, and tools grouped by usage.

online.title: 100% online
online.text: Processing starts from the browser and keeps the same flow across all tool pages.

privacy.title: Automatic deletion
privacy.text: Files are temporary and retention stays limited.

multilingual.title: Multilingual
multilingual.text: The same homepage exists in French, English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

simplePremium.title: Simple, then premium
simplePremium.text: Free tools stay direct while advanced features add more control.

advanced.title: The browser will become the advanced editing workspace
advanced.text: PDF previews, visual page selection, hand-placed signatures, OCR, translation, and history will follow the simple engines.

allTools.title: All Foliant tools
allTools.text: The full catalog stays visible at the bottom so navigation remains consistent everywhere.

home.workspaceTitle: One clear space for every document
home.workspaceText: The page guides users to one main action, then suggests related tools when the file is ready.
home.stepsText: The flow stays short: file, action, result. Technical details stay in the background.

upload.title: Upload the file
upload.text: Select a PDF, Office document, image, or Markdown file.

choose.title: Choose the action
choose.text: Compress, convert, merge, sign, or reorder pages.

download.title: Download the result
download.text: Get the final file, run another action, or delete temporary files.

free.a: Yes, the free limit lets users process a few files per day. Higher volumes and advanced features can move to a paid plan.

install.q: Do I need to install software?
install.a: No. The tools run directly in the browser on desktop and mobile.

privacy.a: Files are stored temporarily for processing, then automatically deleted after a few hours.

signature.a: The first version focuses on simple visual signing. It does not replace certified electronic signatures.

home.toolsText: The most common tools stay visible. The rest of the catalog stays accessible without overloading the page.

convert.title: Convert and edit PDFs
convert.description: Convert to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, or image, then reorder pages, add text, a watermark, or page numbers.

compress.title: Compress large files
compress.description: Reduce PDF and image size so they are faster to send by email, WhatsApp, or online forms.

merge.title: Merge multiple documents
merge.description: Combine several PDF files in the right order, then download one clean document.

sign.title: Visually sign a PDF
sign.description: Draw or import a signature, place it on the document, then download a visually signed PDF.
